title: observability-token-kv-cost-latency-dashboard-enhancements-and-alert-tuning
author: Laura Chen
description: Motivation: token-level KV cache metrics and finer cost/latency breakdowns are critical for proactive cost controls and incident detection. This PR enhances the existing token-level cost/latency dashboard, adds new KV cache-specific metrics and traces, standardizes span names for downstream tooling, and tunes alert thresholds to reduce noisy alerts while keeping SLO coverage. Summary of changes: 1) New dashboard: observability/dashboards/token_kv_cost_latency.json - aggregated token-level cost and latency panels with per-model and per-queue breakdowns, 2) Metrics collector: observability/metrics/kv_metrics_collector.go - adds exported metrics: redwood_kv_cache_requests_total, redwood_kv_cache_hits_total, redwood_kv_cache_miss_latency_seconds_bucket, redwood_token_cost_per_model, redwood_token_latency_percentiles; includes labels model, region, customer_tier, route, cache_tier, and quantization_profile, 3) Tracing: observability/tracing/span_names.md - standardized span naming for KV cache and token-generation so traces join correctly across services, 4) Alerts: observability/alerts/token_kv_alerts.yaml - new composite alerts and tuned thresholds; added alert suppression windows for predictable batch jobs, 5) Documentation and rollout: deploy/rollout/README.md - rollout plan and config flags for enabling the new metrics in Dedicated and Private deployments, 6) Tests: tests/integration/observability_test.go - integration test that validates metrics emission and basic dashboard queries. Checklist: - [x] Metrics instrumented and unit-tested, - [x] Dashboard JSON exported and validated against Grafana schema, - [x] Alerts reviewed with SRE and tuned to reduce false positives, - [x] Rollout plan documented with feature-flag, - [x] Backwards compatible: metrics are additive and default thresholds preserve current behavior. Testing and CI: unit tests added for the metrics collector and linting applied to dashboard JSON. CI run history: initial CI had a flaky integration failure in observability_test.go (timeout on Grafana query) which was fixed by increasing the test retry window and mocking the query in CI; final CI run passed. Rationale: adding labels (cache_tier and quantization_profile) enables fine-grained cost attribution and ensures the Optimize tooling can recommend quantization profiles per workload. Rollout plan: canary enable metrics for 5% of Dedicated capacity for 48 hours, monitor token-level cost and alert noise, then ramp to 100% over 72 hours if no regressions. Backout: feature-flag allows disabling metric emission instantly. Related work: ENG-5172 (token-level observability epic), ENG-5220 (KV cache metrics), SUP-884 (customer-reported noisy alerts).
commits: feat(metrics): add KV cache metrics and token cost/latency counters
docs(tracing): standardize span names for kv and token generation
chore(alerts): add token_kv composite alerts and suppression windows
test(observability): integration tests for metric emission and dashboard queries
chore(rollout): rollout docs and feature flag gating
review_conversation: Evan Miller (reviewer): Please clarify the cardinality impact of the new labels; are we at risk of high series churn?

Laura Chen (author): We scoped labels to model, region, customer_tier, route, cache_tier, quantization_profile and added a cardinality cap in the exporter; we will sample unknown/rare values into an 'other' bucket. See metrics_collector.go for implementation details.
Priya Nair (reviewer): Alert thresholds look reasonable but can we add a cooldown for the KV-miss spike alert?
Laura Chen (author): Added suppression windows and a 10m cooldown to the composite alert; documented in token_kv_alerts.yaml.
Julian Park (approver): Integration test flake fixed and mocks look good. Approving.
SRE Rotation Bot: Noted potential high-cardinality on quantization_profile; scheduled a follow-up runbook item to review cardinality after 1 week of canary.
Evan Miller (final): approved — left a minor nit on dashboard panel descriptions which was addressed.
merge_commit_message:
squash: observability - token KV cost/latency dashboards + alerts

Adds KV metrics, dashboard, tracing doc, tuned alerts, integration tests, and rollout docs.
release_notes: Enhancement: Token-level KV cache metrics and token cost/latency panels added to observability dashboards.
Added: Prometheus metrics redwood_kv_cache_requests_total, redwood_kv_cache_hits_total, redwood_kv_cache_miss_latency_seconds_bucket, redwood_token_cost_per_model, redwood_token_latency_percentiles.
Fix: Tuning of token/KV alerts to reduce noise; suppression windows added for predictable batch workloads.
notes: Deployed behind feature flag; monitor redwood_kv_cache_* series for cardinality during canary. Follow-up: ENG-5290 to add sampled export for rare quantization profiles.
